newsitem.title: FRANCE: France picks Credit du Nord bid for Laydernier.
newsitem.headline: France picks Credit du Nord bid for Laydernier.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis said on Friday he had chosen an offer by Credit du Nord for Banque Laydernier, a bank owned by state controlled bank Credit Lyonnais which is being privatised.

A Finance Ministry statement said the decision had been taken in consultation with France's privatisation commission and that the choice had been taken in line with a series of conditions among which one was the buyer's ability to preserve the bank's identity.
It did not give financial details.
Credit du Nord itself belongs to Groupe Paribas.
